reviews.author: C-Dub
reviews.text: A five-star park and general area.  I took away a star though for the campground as the sites are way too close to each other to truly enjoy the camping experience.  You can hear every word spoken in the adjacent campsites while just using a normal conversational voice.  We paid almost $300 for four nights and I expect better for that kind of money.  50amp service and even sewer connects at each site is nice if you have an RV but I'm making the effort to go out into nature to get away from people a little bit. I don't like being 10 ft away from the group right next to me, especially if they have multiple children and pets. Malawa Lake itself is absolutely gorgeous and if you haven't been there and to the accompanying town of Joseph you're really missing out on a natural wonder. That said the campground is just designed too tightly to enjoy unless you're looking for that sort of loud group atmosphere. Perhaps during a shoulder season weekday it would be nicer but we were there with the park at capacity and it was just like being in the city with the noise level amount of people everywhere.

reviews.author: a rod
reviews.text: Fun campsite with a lot to do. The Marina has rentals for boats, paddle boards and other items. The bathrooms at the state park have showers with hot water. Nearby there are a couple of small restaurants, two mini golf courses, go karts and the Wallowa Lake tramway. First time here and will plan another trip.

reviews.author: This moms Crazy Life
reviews.text:
Our stay at Group Campsite B in Wallowa  was wonderful! Mother Nature gave us a show and we had a thunderstorm the entire first night, but honestly, it was actually beautiful to listen to!
We took it as part of our adventure, and made for a really cool experience!
We had some adorable very friendly deer visitors 🦌🤗

Our Camp Hosts were not very friendly, or inviting unfortunately, so that was sad to experience. Several members of our group, had experienced the same treatment, so it was not just a one off thing.  Sad face!  Thankfully, we really only needed to interact with them while getting firewood!

The Rangers on the other hand were all super friendly, and very informative.

Bathrooms and showers SUPER clean!

If you’re thinking about the regular single sites, just a heads-up: they’re pretty cozy with hardly any shrubs or bushes for privacy.

The lake was beautiful! We did one lake day, but it was not for us. It had a fishy smell to it that we couldn’t get past unfortunately.
Ultimately we decided there’s more fun to be had elsewhere. Perhaps if we had planned some fun boating activities it would have been a different experience.  🏖️ area was rocky, so I would recommend chairs for sure when hanging out lakeside.

The starry nights? Out of this world! Perfect for all stargazers.

Just a quick stroll away is a charming little town with horseback riding, go-carts, and plenty of fun stuff to keep the family busy.

There are cute little shopping stores within walking distance, plus coffee shops and even mini golf. We had some delicious Thai food from KHAO NEAOW while waiting for friends to come back from horseback riding — yum! The owner mentioned she had been in town for 12 years!  If you have the opportunity, I would recommend giving it a try.

The tram ride up? A total must! The views at the top of the short hikes are stunning!
you’ll seriously regret missing those views!

The restaurant was reasonably priced, and the Caesar wraps ended up being the family favorites!

There are very friendly critters up there that are not afraid to come up and check out what snacks you are willing to share. They were so adorable, we didn’t mind them at all!

Need groceries? Safeway’s a quick 20-minute drive away. And don’t forget to swing by the beautiful town of Joseph — it’s like a little slice of magic.

All in all, a fantastic spot for camping, adventure, and making memories. We’re already dreaming of our next trip back!

reviews.author: Mustafa M
reviews.text:
A true gem for nature lovers 🌲💛. Wallowa State Park offers breathtaking views, peaceful trails, and a chance to truly disconnect and unwind. During Kokanee spawning season, the rivers come alive with a stunning display of nature in motion — it’s a magical sight you won’t want to miss.

The park has clean bathroom facilities, and there are plenty of options for lake rentals, including paddle boats, kayaks, paddleboards, and pontoons, making it easy to enjoy the water.

The tramway is amazing, offering one of the steepest gondola rides in North America — a must-do for incredible panoramic views of the mountains and lake. The campgrounds are well-maintained, and the sunsets over the Wallowas are unforgettable. Perfect for anyone looking to immerse themselves in the beauty of Northeast Oregon!

reviews.author: Renée Hardiman
reviews.text: Very nice campground on a lovely lake. The homes of the town abut the edge of the campground. The lake had good launches for towed boats and for kayaks. The area is touted as the "Switzerland of America," which is a bit of an overstatement.  The gateway town of Joseph reminds me a little bit of Estes Park - upscale seasonal tourist town. This Rec Area is remote, and only one way in/out for normal vehicles. The tram ride up Mount Howard was $50 apiece. It was cloudy and had very limited hours in late ,,May, so we didn't ride.

reviews.author: Kevin K
reviews.title: Excellent campground.
reviews.text: I went in October…it was crisp fall-like weather. Stayed in a yurt.  Great experience for my disabled family. Loved it, so much that I’m  Moving to joseph. In just over a week.  The yurt was warm, clean and suitable for at least six people.  The heater and air purifier were a bonus, and they worked fine.  The rangers were knowledgeable and courteous, allowed me to check  in a few hours early. Points for that!  Next day the deer came to investigate enforce.. they came so close  begging for food they nuzzled my wife’s hand and sons arm.  incredible. My son was enthralled and amazed. He too was hooked.  Bathrooms were clean. Shower was sufficient. It’s a campground shower,  So, it had its detractors. But was clean and hot.  Definitely going back. Great time is the off season.  Been there in the summer months. Not a spot, site or yurt to be had.  Will ever go in peak season again.

reviews.author: Glenn P
reviews.title: Popular Park
reviews.text: Stayed in C41 pull through in a 40ft fifth wheel. The space was fairly level but the curve of the road and trees that need to trimmed forced me to back out of the site. 50 amp service, water & sewer with good table and fire ring. Choose your site carefully if you have a big rig. Washrooms and showers were emaculate and staff helpful.

reviews.author: Theodor H
reviews.title: A crown jewel in the Oregon State Park system
reviews.text: This is one of the crown jewels in the extensive Oregon State Park system. The camp ground is great. Lots of amenities. The lake is fantastic as are the mountains. Take the tramway -- available just outside of the park boundary -- to check out the view. Well worth the stay.

reviews.author: MDB
reviews.title: Small quiet park with beach area
reviews.text: Come see this beautiful lake and small but nice and clean park. Bring a picnic. There are restrooms with running water and a little beach area. It’s dog friendly.

reviews.author: Steven F
reviews.title: Great Camping
reviews.text: Clean and scenic surroundings with friendly and dedicated State Park employees. Quite a variety of camping options with plenty to do and see around Wallowa Lake.

reviews.author: griffethbarker
reviews.title: Stunning country
reviews.text: Visited for a friend's wedding. Arrived a couple of days early and explored around the lake. Absolutely beautiful country here. Don't miss out!

reviews.author: Ama
reviews.title: Don't bother
reviews.text: I would highly recommend camping somewhere else. This park is extremely crowded, no privacy, and not very welcoming if your a POC. My friend and I were being constantly stared and it was uncomfortable. We paid for a second night but decided to just leave. Highly disappointed given that we drove 4-5 hours to get to this location. The lake and views are decent but you could find something better elsewhere.

reviews.author: Sharon382
reviews.title: Yrly Family Get-A-Way
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting State Park. Was recommended by many of our friends. We had our kids, grandkids and friends with us in group. Stayed 1 wk in C section, very relaxing time. Park very clean and all workers very friendly and helpful. We will be returning yearly.

reviews.author: Proszey85
reviews.title: Nice campground
reviews.text: Camping was good. The area is clean and busy! The bathrooms and free showers were nicely cleaned daily. The sight we had was with power, which was nice. Water also at sites.  Firewood for sale, $5 a cart full.  An easy walk to the lake and the corner store.  Little disappointed in the beach, but given that the lake is 5 feet higher right now.. the area around the beach was mushy/ muddy.  The normally large beach was gone for now. We enjoyed sitting at the marina watching people going out on rentable boats, pontoons and kayaks.

reviews.author: mattloaf1
reviews.title: Beautiful park
reviews.text: This is the best state park I’ve camped at, great facilities and amazing setting. But the real reason I’m posting is to let everyone know i got 4-5 bars of AT&T LTE at the campground, which contradicts a lot of older reviews. Obviously they have recently installed a tower nearby. Great signal, you could do actual work from here if you had to.

reviews.author: Justchillin
reviews.title: Beautiful lake, nice campground
reviews.text: We loved this park we had a nice site a pull thru with full hook up. The lake was so calm every day and the fishing was great. We took the cable cars up to the top of mount Howard and hiked in the snow, had drinks at the summit. We trolled for Kokanee in our kayak got an 18” and 15”. There are a few towns not far with a nice Safeway. Our site had some privacy but 3 campers set up across and next to us wit 10 young boys and 2 girls all around the age of 7 and they all cut through our site all day long including the parents till we said something to them. Some still kept doing it I think parents should teach their kids not to do that. You can’t pick you neighbors. Our neighbors on the other side complained to the park.

reviews.author: Camp Cookies
reviews.title: Lots of room, lots of fish in the lake!
reviews.text: We stayed at Wallowa Lake State Park and really enjoyed it, we baked Brownies with extra walnuts for our snacks. We went up the Wallowa Lake Tram to the top of MT Howard, what a view! the restaurant at the top Summit Grill for lunch and hiked around the trails before coming down. I fished every day and had a blast, paid for the stay in Fresh Fish. Campfires in the pit, fire wood for sale from camp hosts. We had a huge pull thru site with plenty of room for our large rig and truck. There were lots of deer walking thru the site every day. We did the Joseph Railrider trip and that was a blast to do! We walked around the local little towns, nice market in Joseph with everything you need more of, we needed a few things for the road and picked up some sandwichws for the next day's driving. Check out the Blue Banana, and do not miss the little “mini donut ”shop in Joseph, oh yes!
